title: Better Recipe & Smelts
description: Better Recipe & Smelts is a quality-of-life datapack designed to expand and rebalance Minecraft’s crafting and smelting systems in a way that feels logical, intuitive, and faithful to vanilla gameplay
body:
Better Recipe & Smelts is a quality-of-life datapack designed to expand and rebalance Minecraft’s crafting and smelting systems in a way that feels logical, intuitive, and faithful to vanilla gameplay. Instead of introducing overpowered mechanics, this datapack focuses on improving efficiency and common-sense recipes that many players feel should have existed from the beginning. It is made to seamlessly integrate into survival worlds, modpacks, and long-term playthroughs without breaking progression or immersion.

The datapack enhances crafting logic by reducing unnecessary waste and improving block conversion. Core materials are treated consistently, allowing players to recover or convert blocks in more reasonable ways. This makes building, survival, and automation smoother while still respecting resource value and balance.

Smelting and furnace logic are also expanded to make better use of existing items. Items that feel naturally convertible through heat or processing now have practical outcomes, encouraging exploration, scavenging, and alternative progression paths. These changes help early-game survival, improve late-game efficiency, and reduce frustration caused by unused or “junk” items.

Better Recipe & Smelts is designed to work as a standalone datapack or as an additional datapack for modpacks. It is especially suitable for survival-focused, hardcore, apocalypse, or vanilla-plus experiences where gameplay depth matters more than flashy features.

FEATURES INCLUDED

Crafting Improvements

* One full block can be crafted into double slabs, reducing material loss
* Droppers can be upgraded into dispensers through crafting
* Blackstone is treated as cobblestone, allowing it to be used in all recipes that require cobblestone
* Copper can be used to craft rails as an alternative conductive material
* Coal can be crafted into black dye for better material consistency

Smelting Improvements

* Rotten flesh can be smelted into leather
* Powder blocks can be smelted into their solid glass variants
* Expanded furnace logic to make item processing feel more realistic

Recipe Expansions

* Enchanted Golden Apple recipe added in a balanced, survival-friendly way
* Additional logical recipes that respect vanilla progression
* Tweaks designed to reduce grind without removing challenge

Design Philosophy

* Vanilla-friendly and survival-balanced
* No new items required, only logical extensions
* Works in singleplayer and multiplayer
* Ideal for long-term worlds and modpacks
* Easy to combine with other datapacks and mods

Better Recipe & Smelts is not about making Minecraft easier, but about making it make sense. It turns wasted resources into meaningful options, improves crafting flow, and enhances survival gameplay while staying true to the spirit of the game.
